flags.why: “Bệnh hen dễ phát bệnh” is unnatural because phát bệnh normally describes a person developing symptoms, not an illness developing an illness.
flags.fix: Người bị hen dễ phát bệnh khi trời trở lạnh. = People with asthma are prone to developing symptoms when the weather turns cold.

flags.why: The catch-fire sense remains current and should not be labelled dated ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-ph%C3%A1t%20h%E1%BB%8Fa)).
The open-fire sense remains current in military usage and should not be labelled dated ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-ph%C3%A1t%20h%E1%BB%8Fa)).
Phân bì means comparing enviously, not discriminating between or against pupils ([dictionary](https://vdict.com/ph%C3%A2n%20b%C3%AC%2C3%2C0%2C0.html)).
